verdict.rationale: incident.io exposes a well-documented public API (api.incident.io) with a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec and per-tag machine-readable specs, plus webhooks and an MCP server that can query incidents, alerts, on-call, and escalations — strong evidence of broad API coverage. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of full feature parity (e.g. Terraform provider is still being built resource-by-resource, and AI features like Investigations/Scribe/summaries aren't clearly exposed as API-manageable), so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement/documentation, API coverage for AI-driven features (investigations, scribe, suggestions), and confirmation Terraform/infra-as-code covers all resources.
